title: Mean and median of four sleep times
description: Four children's sleep times are used to find the mean by sharing the total and the median by putting the values in order. The video breaks Keeko's doubt that the median comes from the middle of the unordered list.
teaching_notes: One idea: the mean needs the total shared equally, and the median needs the values in order first. Watch for students who take the middle of the list as given.

source: Four children in a group sleep 9, 8.5, 10 and 9 hours. Find
video_script.why: The child can find an average and now also finds the median, which needs the values in order.
video_script.substitution: For the mean add and divide by the count; for the median put the values in order and average the middle two.
video_script.anchor: four sleep cards for the four children, placed in a row
video_script.wrong_answer: the median is nine and a quarter hours
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko takes the middle two of the list as given, eight and a half and ten, without putting the values in order.
video_script.payoff_line: the mean is about nine point one hours and the median is nine hours

final_answer.spoken: the mean is about nine point one hours and the median is nine hours

maths_rules: with four values the median is the average of the middle two: (9 + 9) / 2 = 9 hours
slip: the middle two of the unordered list are 8.5 and 10, which gives 9.25, a wrong median
video_script.design: One idea: add and divide for the mean, order then take the middle for the median. The wrong idea is taking the middle of the list as given. The four sleep cards stay on screen all video.

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This question is from your book.
<bookmark mark='cards'/>Four children in a group sleep nine, eight and a half, ten and nine hours.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>Find the mean and the median of their sleep time.

beats.on_screen: the question stays on the board; Keeko sits at the corner of the board

marks.think: Keeko appears at the corner of the board

beats.on_screen: the cards levelled for the mean; the cards lined up smallest to largest with the middle marked for the median

marks.mean: the cards are levelled to the same height and labelled mean
marks.order: the cards are lined up from the smallest to the largest
marks.mid: the middle of the line is marked and labelled median

narration: <bookmark mark='mean'/>The mean is the total shared equally among all the values.
<bookmark mark='order'/>For the median, first put the values in order from the smallest to the largest.
<bookmark mark='mid'/>The median is the middle of that line. With four values, it is halfway between the middle two.

beats.on_screen: Given: sleep of four children = 9, 8.5, 10, 9 hours

marks.given: the four values are written in a row

narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, the sleep times are nine, eight and a half, ten and nine hours.

beats.on_screen: To find: the mean and the median of the sleep times

marks.find: the task is written under the given

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the mean and the median of the four sleep times.

beats.on_screen: Step 1: mean needs the total: 9 + 8.5 + 10 + 9 = 36.5 hours

marks.add: the four values are added into one total of thirty six and a half

narration: <bookmark mark='add'/>Step one, for the mean add the four values. The total is thirty six and a half hours.

beats.on_screen: Step 2: mean = total / number of values = 36.5 / 4

marks.div: the working thirty six and a half divided by four is written

narration: <bookmark mark='div'/>Step two, divide the total by the number of values. That is thirty six and a half divided by four.

marks.order: the cards are put in order, eight and a half, nine, nine, ten
marks.mid: the middle two cards are ringed
marks.avg: the working nine plus nine, divided by two, is written

narration: <bookmark mark='order'/>Step three, for the median put the values in order. They are eight and a half, nine, nine and ten.
<bookmark mark='mid'/>The middle two are nine and nine.
<bookmark mark='avg'/>Add them and divide by two.

beats.on_screen: Answer: Mean about 9.1 hours, median 9 hours

marks.ans: the mean and the median are boxed side by side

narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>The mean is about nine point one hours and the median is nine hours.

narration: <bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

marks.doubt: the middle two cards of the list as given, eight and a half and ten, are ringed
marks.order: the ring is struck out and the cards are put in order
marks.mid: the new middle two, nine and nine, are ringed

beats.removed: the first ring is struck out
narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the median is nine and a quarter hours. Keeko took the middle two of the list as given.
<bookmark mark='order'/>But the values must be put in order first.
<bookmark mark='mid'/>After that, the middle two are nine and nine.
